Didn't make Day 2 of the Regional Championship? Maybe you want to face some of the best players in the world. This event is perfect for competitive Riftbound players. Event cap is 1024 players. 256 seats will be held for Regional Championship competitors. Competitors will play 1v1 Constructed. This event requires decklist submission. 6 Rounds Day 1. 5 Rounds Day 2. Players at 12 Match Points or more will advance to Day 2. Best of 3. Rounds have a 60 minute time limit. Each player seated for Round 1 will be awarded a Participation Promo card. All remaining prizes are awarded by the end of Round 10.
